crossRefs.note: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe…
Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.
All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

translations.web: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
translations.bsb: where they presented false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.
translations.kjv: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
translations.asv: and set up false witnesses, who said, This man ceaseth not to speak words against this holy place, and the law:
